# LifePot

> LifePot is an open-source artificial-life game and educational experiment. Describe a world and fitness priorities, then explore a cellular ecosystem in a deterministic 50×50 simulation.

Jev proposes typed ecology choices; LifePot validates them; deterministic code executes them. Replaying a challenge uses its recorded choices and makes no model call.

## Play and inspect

- [LifePot overview](https://lifepot.modepot.io/): product overview, mechanism, and learning entry point.
- [Play LifePot](https://lifepot.modepot.io/play): create and replay an artificial-life world.
- [Player guide](https://lifepot.modepot.io/learn/player-guide): learn setup vocabulary, controls, observation, outcomes, and replay limits.
- [Developer reference](https://lifepot.modepot.io/learn/developer-reference): exact schemas, rule graph, engine ownership, decision ledger, replay validation, and deployment boundaries.
- [Agent guide Markdown](https://lifepot.modepot.io/learn/developer-reference/markdown): canonical downloadable developer guide.
- [Agent documentation index](https://lifepot.modepot.io/learn): page map for humans and coding agents; canonical guides can be read online or downloaded as Markdown.
- [Project README](https://lifepot.modepot.io/project-docs/readme): source-driven public rendering of repository `README.md` with commit provenance.
- [Roadmap](https://lifepot.modepot.io/project-docs/roadmap): source-driven rendering of optional `ROADMAP.md`; planned work is clearly not shipped.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/tugrulguner/lifepot): application code, deterministic simulation rules, tests, and deployment configuration.
- [Sitemap](https://lifepot.modepot.io/sitemap.xml): public crawlable routes.
- [Robots policy](https://lifepot.modepot.io/robots.txt): crawler access policy.
- [ModePot](https://modepot.io/): return to the open-source project family.

## Architecture and boundaries

- The world is a deterministic 50×50 cellular simulation after the initial choices are accepted.
- Model output is typed data, never executable code.
- LifePot validates proposed choices before the simulation runs.
- Replays use recorded choices and make no model call.
- LifePot is a game and educational toy, not a biological forecast.
- There is no installable package or supported public API. `/api/judge` is an internal application endpoint; the supported user interface is the hosted web game.
